description: Stratified 12-sample regression and semantic-review set with one single-point and one multi-point sample for each core goal type.
selection_rationale: Provide a repo-stored long-term baseline that covers eqratio, eqangle, simtri, simtrir, contri, and contrir across both single-point and multi-point auxiliary constructions.

records.goal_text: eqratio a e b d e g b f
records.notes: Useful for checking whether a single midpoint-style helper genuinely closes a ratio chain instead of only sounding plausible.

records.goal_text: eqangle a b a c a d a e
records.notes: Useful for checking whether the writer can keep angle-side closure grounded after a cyclic plus collinear single-point construction.

records.goal_text: simtrir b d e c e g
records.notes: Useful for checking whether a similarity route built from parallel and perpendicular support stays explicit and ordered.

records.goal_text: simtri a c g f a g
records.notes: Useful for checking whether double-cyclic support is converted into explicit similarity-side bridge relations rather than high-level circle talk.

records.goal_text: contri b c f f e b
records.notes: Useful for checking whether a single-point congruence setup is followed by a real triangle-congruence closure instead of a fake similarity shortcut.

records.goal_text: contrir b d i i f b
records.notes: Useful for checking whether reverse-congruence style closure remains tied to explicit angle and perpendicular support.

records.goal_text: eqratio b e c e d e b e
records.notes: Useful for checking whether a multi-point ratio route can keep staged roles clear across parallel, congruence, and cyclic supports.

records.goal_text: eqangle a e c e d f c f
records.notes: Useful for checking whether a mixed collinear and perpendicular multi-point construction is explained in stages and closed back to an angle target.

records.goal_text: simtri a b e d c a
records.notes: Useful for checking whether a three-mechanism multi-point construction can reach a true similarity closure without route drift.

records.goal_text: simtrir a g i i g h
records.notes: Useful for checking whether reverse-similarity closure stays grounded when the helper route mixes perpendicular, parallel, and congruence relations.

records.goal_text: contri a b d c d b
records.notes: Useful for checking whether a longer staged congruence route remains explicit about why each new point exists.

records.goal_text: contrir a c h d b h
records.notes: Useful for checking whether midpoint language in a multi-point setting stays concrete and still closes to the reverse-congruence target.
